headline: Ebos, Fletcher earnings drive NZX 50 higher
summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 was among the stronger Asian performers for a second day. Investors reacted to results from Ebos Group and Fletcher Building, which kept the benchmark positive.
why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark equity index, tracking the largest listed companies. Heavyweight results can move the index significantly.
